# Feature Request

## Summary

Provide a clear and concise description of the feature.

---

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem this feature would solve.

---

## Proposed Solution

Explain how you would like this feature to work.

---

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

---

## Benefits

Explain how this feature would improve LoanWise AI.

---

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, mockups, examples, or references if applicable.

---

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues before creating this request.
- [ ] This is a feature request and not a bug report.
- [ ] I have clearly explained the proposed feature.
- [ ] I have included any relevant context.
